## About
Magic Auto is a used car sales, maintenance and repair, and body work shop on Northwest Highway, just north of downtown Des Plaines. Our experienced staff works on cars, vans, SUVs and limos, from basic oil changes all the way to rebuilding your engine.
Our body shop takes care of collision repairs, including insurance work, along with paint jobs, dent removal and modifications. And if you're shopping for a used vehicle, every car we sell is inspected by our own repairmen first, so you don't get any surprises.
The shop is run by the owner, Dimo, and some of our customers have been bringing their cars to us for years. Give us a call or stop by and see for yourself.

## Services
- Maintenance: Engine and transmission oil changes, brakes, tires and coolant.
- Computerized diagnostics: We track down what's wrong with computerized problem diagnostics.
- Electrical and suspension repairs: Repairs on radiators, electrical systems, engines and suspension.
- Body shop and collision repair: Collision repairs including insurance work, paint jobs and modifications.
- Used car sales: A constantly updated inventory of reliable used vehicles.

## FAQ
Q: Do you handle insurance work on collision repairs?
A: Yes. Our body shop performs collision repairs, including insurance work.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Cars, vans, SUVs and limos, for anything from a basic oil change to an engine rebuild.

Q: Are your used cars checked before they're sold?
A: Yes. Every car is inspected by our own repairmen before it's sold, so you don't have to worry about surprises.
